subject: Contract assembly for capacity uplift — final paperwork and MSA edits
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@steelwave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@steelwave.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Contract assembly for capacity uplift — MSA/OrderForm sync

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're ready to move forward with the 50% capacity uplift starting Feb 1, 2027 but need to finalize paperwork on the MSA side before procurement signs the PO.

Two asks from legal/procurement:
- Can Redwood accept a Net 45 payment term for the first quarter of the uplift (temporary concession)?
- Exhibit E needs the new seat/tier mapping and a clarified termination notice (we proposed 60 days).

I've attached SteelWave's PO (PO_56781.pdf) and our consolidated cover sheet with the requested billing code. Please send an annotated MSA and the updated order form so our procurement/legal can route.

Target timeline: signature by Jan 14 so finance can process the Jan invoices.

Thanks,

Ellen Park
Head of Cloud Platforms
SteelWave

Attachments: PO_56781.pdf, SteelWave_CoverSheet.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@steelwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract assembly for capacity uplift — MSA/OrderForm sync

Ellen — great news, and congrats on getting internal signoff for the uplift.

Attached: MSA_v3_annotated.pdf (our proposed edits), OrderForm_SurgeCap_2027.xlsx (merged capacity table + billing codes).
High-level notes:
- We can accommodate Net 45 for Q1 as a one-time billing term; added a short clause in Section 4.2 to reflect temporary payment terms and a reversion to standard Net 30 after Apr 1.
- Proposed Exhibit E: updated seat mappings, surge bucket definition, and 60-day termination notice language (we tracked changes in the PDF).
- Small ask from Legal: we softened the indemnity carve (Section 9) to add explicit data-scope limits for hosted models — Kimberly, FYI for review.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly to confirm legal OK on indemnity/data scope.
2) Lauren to prepare final signature packet and route to DocuSign (we'll include the PO and cover sheet).
3) Ellen — if procurement can confirm the signatory and approver chain (name + email), we'll route today and aim for Jan 12 signature.

Thanks — attaching the files now.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_v3_annotated.pdf, OrderForm_SurgeCap_2027.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@steelwave.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract assembly for capacity uplift — MSA/OrderForm sync

Quick notes from Legal (see inline):

- Section 9 (Indemnity): we limited indemnity to claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct; added data-scope language so it doesn't expand to third-party model outputs beyond what's in the SLA.
- Data retention: proposed 90 days default for cached inference data unless customer requests extended retention (we added opt-in language in Section 5.3).
- Exhibit E: clarified surge bucket calculations (per-minute token aggregation) and included an example row to avoid billing disputes.

If SteelWave needs stronger indemnity language, we'll need C-level approval — suggest keeping this in the packet for now and noting it as an exclusion in the signoff cover sheet so procurement can decide.

Monica — I've left comments in MSA_v3_annotated.pdf. Lauren: please include a callout about the indemnity note on the cover sheet.

Kimberly
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@steelwave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@steelwave.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract assembly for capacity uplift — MSA/OrderForm sync

Thanks team — the edits read cleanly.

Procurement confirms the signatory is: Marcus Chen <marcus.chen@steelwave.com>. We'll process the PO as soon as DocuSign is live. We're OK with the temporary Net 45 for Q1.

I've attached our PO again (PO_56781.pdf) and a short Procurement Acceptance memo. Please route the DocuSign to Marcus and cc procurement@steelwave.com.

If you can start the DocuSign today, we'll aim for signature by Jan 10.

Best,
Ellen

Attachments: PO_56781.pdf, SW_Procurement_Acceptance.pdf
